text:
maria: dropping this thread for tomorrow's sync  new idea: a "hush ribbon" inside the alert preview that shows compact per-medium silence ranges plus a tiny scrubber to preview the incident timeline alignment. mock: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/hush-ribbon-proto.png

anil: Interesting. A11y first-pass: the scrubber must expose time context and be keyboard draggable. SR should be able to query the scrubber position (e.g., "scrubber at 10:12, shows Pager quiet 10:00-10:30"). Use role=slider for the scrubber and aria-valuetext to surface time. Avoid color-only cues for segments.

lisa: Copy thought: let's call the component "Hush ribbon" in the panel, but show friendly microcopy: "Hush windows temporarily stop notifications for these channels." Button: "Edit hush window". Keep backend term "suppression" for logs.

devin: Perf/shape: rendering a scrubber + many tiny segments could be heavy. Suggest server coalescing by contiguous time ranges per medium and returning a flattened array: `hush: [{medium:'Pager', start:'', end:'', count:1, auto:true}]`. Frontend then paints coalesced ranges.

jake: Keyboard and SR pattern: treat the ribbon as a composite widget. Scrubber = role=slider; segments = role=listitem with aria-posinset. On scrub position change emit polite live announcement like "Scrubber at 10:15. Pager hush active." Also ensure focusable hit targets >=44px.

tara: Mobile: no hover. Show a condensed pill that toggles the scrubber in a modal. In modal include timezone hint: "Times shown in your local timezone (PST)" and an explicit link to view incident timeline alignment.

emily: Visual nit: when hush windows cross DST boundaries or timezone offsets, show a tiny clock icon with tooltip "local time adjusted". Users in EMEA complained about cross-zone confusion.

maria: UX question  should the scrubber snap to segment boundaries or allow free scrub? Snap helps file edits but free scrub helps quick preview. Thoughts?

jake: I'd prefer free scrub with optional snap-on-edit mode. Keyboard arrows snap by 5-minute increments, shift+arrow for 30-minute jumps. Document in keyboard spec.

devin: Data note: if we add scrubber telemetry, include the last scrub position in the preview payload to avoid re-render jank on reopen. Also coalesce on server if segments < 6px wide.

anil: Accessibility follow-up: provide a summary button that opens a text list of active hush windows for SR users. e.g., "Show hush window list" -> reads: "Pager: 10:00-10:30 (auto). Slack: 10:05-10:20 (user)". This helps non-visual users who can't parse the timeline.

lisa: Copy for the summary list header: "Hush windows (text view)" and the helper: "Text summary of hush windows for accessibility and exports."

tara: Mobile copy for the pill: "2 channels hushed"; modal header: "Hush ribbon — 2 channels"; CTA: "Edit hush windows". No hover interactions.

emily: Micro-interaction idea: when a hush window is system-generated, animate a subtle badge (pulse once) to draw attention and add tooltip "Auto-hush (policy triggered)". But keep motion reduced for accessibility prefs.

maria: Action items: 1) maria -> mock: add scrubber + timezone hint 2) anil -> a11y micro-spec including summary list and slider ARIA mappings 3) lisa -> finalize copy strings for ribbon, pill, summary 4) devin -> propose coalesced hush payload and lastScrubPosition field 5) jake -> keyboard + snap behavior doc 6) tara -> mobile modal flow. I'll upload mock updates before EOD.

emily: tiny UX ask  show a small "align to incident timeline" toggle so users can see hush ranges relative to incident start. Helpful for triage.

maria: noted, adding that toggle to mocks. Thanks everyone  ping me for blockers. :)
